summary: Routes 14, 23, 41, and 56 will travel using Woodland St to S 5th St inbound and outbound from 10 a.m. until 4 p.m. Nissan Stadium Stop is Woodland & S 1st. No Service on N 1st or S 1st Street.
interpretation: Operator-published October 11 service change for four routes at the Nissan Stadium stop. A dated notice does not verify vehicle movement, actual stop service, crowd effect or a threat.
